CustomField.description: The option name and its annual premium on one line, for pickers in flows.
CustomField.label: Option Summary
CustomField.formula: IF(ISBLANK(Annual_Premium__c), Name, Name & ", $" & IF(Annual_Premium__c >= 1000, TEXT(FLOOR(Annual_Premium__c / 1000)) & "," & LPAD(TEXT(MOD(FLOOR(Annual_Premium__c), 1000)), 3, "0"), TEXT(FLOOR(Annual_Premium__c))) & " a year")
